lines.text: Umur Jesus 33 sowa takar yeh meh obuoh nyalip. Yeh meh kobos pukul 3 singumi.
3 botang salip de tun pungu.
Yeh meh kobes, meh obuoh ngubur, duoh mokat idip bauh dang onu ke 3.
3 dayung odi nudu makam Eh: Mary Magdalene, Mary sine James, duoh Salome.
Suo de muti takar meh sukup 3 sowa Jesus ngajar.
Adin, kira-kira ogi 1 urang misia suo 3 urang de dunya de ngaku dep eh Christian.
3 sideh Peter nang dep eh doi piruh Jesus.
Takar Yeh meh mokat idip bauh, Jesus sikien duoh yeh 3 sideh:
Muu nyayang oku keh? Mu nyayang oku keh? Mu nyayang oku keh?
Topa yeh leh Sama, Onak duoh Roh Kudus.
Suo koyuh de dunya mokat suo 3 koyuh geh. Warna de paring ayuh neg suo 3 itih: birieh, sia, duoh biru.
Meh branak, meh idip, meh kobes. Do sodi eh, de adin, duoh tie sije.
Masa, ruang, duoh jirim. Ais, piin, duoh gas.
Omu, ayuh, dowoh. Gonan, smongi, duoh roh.
Sama, sine, duoh onak.
Takar dang Gethsemane, Jesus gan jowin eh ke tana, duoh smayang 3 sideh.
Yeh pari ninga Peter, James duoh John. 3 sideh geh, Yeh daped nya munu bees.
Watki Bible tanen nang otte daped obuoh ngramat? Asa te bisaya nang Yeh meh kobes, meh ngubur, ju meh mokat idip bauh.
Dang Bible, numur 3 inuh numur de meh sukup. Asa Topa sobut koyuh 3 sideh, koyuh inuh meh jadi.
Itih leh ruban malaikat nang: Kudus, kudus, kudus.
Topa ngin brokat eh duoh otte pakai 3 koyuh. Nuna oku sobut:
Dang aden Sama, duoh Onak, duoh Roh Kudus. Amen.
Share itih nudu pingoma, madis ayuo, duoh dingan ingan ngan te puan Kiasa Topa.
